evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies RPC request parsing and HTTP response handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an Assume() crash in debug builds and restores JSON-RPC 2.0 spec compliance for error responses. As noted in the description, malformed 2.0 requests previously hit an assertion failure in debug builds, returned non-compliant HTTP 400 in release builds, and mistakenly treated unparseable requests without an id as silent notifications.
